description_expanded: Overview5.0(4 reviews)SEAGROVE- Dogwood Bungalow Coastal Charm | Beach Access | Sleeps 11 DESCRIPTION Dogwood Bungalow sits on coastal pilings, providing a spacious and airy layout perfect for comfortable living and making lasting memories. This 4-bedroom, 2-bath single level sanctuary is just three homes from the sandy beach! OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS The Dogwood Beach Access is just 200 yards away! This home also includes 4 beach chairs for use during your stay. The undercover area provides a shaded gathering spot for grilling and out door dining. HOME FEATURES: Sleeps: 11 4 Bedrooms | 2 Full Baths Guest Bedroom 1: Queen Bed Guest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed Guest Bedroom 3: Queen Bed Guest Bedroom 4: Queen Loft Bed and Twin Daybed Full Bath: Spacious walk-in shower and double vanity. Full Bath: Relaxing tub/shower combination and double vanity. Open-concept Living, Dining, and Kitchen area for seamless gatherings. Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DISCOVER THE MAGIC OF 30A: Immerse yourself in the vibrant tapestry of Florida's Scenic Highway 30A: artsy villages, shimmering coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, lively beach bars, and world-class culinary experiences. Explore 25,000 acres of protected natural beauty, renowned for its welcoming family atmosphere and breathtaking sugar-white beaches. Embark on adventures along the Timpoochee Trail bike path, connecting the distinct charm of each village. Experience the unique character of Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach—all within easy reach. Old Seagrove offers an enchanting blend of coastal charm, modern comfort, and unparalleled access to the best of 30A, creating a vacation experience that will linger in your heart long after you depart.Show less
